parts.t: Deep Cove is unlike any other community in Metro Vancouver — a stunning waterfront village at the end of Indian Arm, surrounded by mountains and ocean inlets. Residents enjoy world-class kayaking, hiking to Quarry Rock, and the warmth of a true village community. Properties here are rare and highly coveted.
